target.failure: The control makes an isolated excursion to an outer V-shaped cusp and returns by z=6000. Marker-free exact-CT slices show the compact inner whorl continuing through z=4900-6100.

candidate_rule.method: linear interpolation of the two pre-existing adjacent trusted independent controls
candidate_rule.reason: Removes the isolated excursion without copying the public annotation or tuning to a downstream metric.

locked_gates: All other controls remain byte-for-coordinate identical.
Exact-CT nearby and orthogonal continuity must not reveal a branch jump.
Lateral step at z=5500 must be no larger than both original adjacent-step maxima.
Villa loader must reproduce every candidate control.
Same-z disagreement and downstream proxy results must be recomputed and reported even if they worsen.
Original v0.1 curve and manifest remain available and unchanged.
claim_boundary: A predeclared correction candidate, not ground truth and not an accepted replacement until every locked gate passes.
